title: Claudearium Profile
description: Declarative spec for claudearium. Edit and run 'reconcile' to bring the sandbox into the described state.

projects.description: Each entry describes one git repository. distroProjects (default) live as bare mirrors inside the distro and sessions are distro-side worktrees. hostProjects (type='host') use a Windows-side checkout; sessions are host-side worktrees mounted into the distro and tools like pwsh/git are wrapped from the host via a per-session PATH shim. See docs/sessions.md.

enabled.description: When false, reconcile tears down the project's infrastructure (mirror or per-project bin dir + all sessions) but preserves the profile entry. Re-enable to recreate everything.

hostCheckout.description: Required when type='host'. Windows path to the user's main checkout; session worktrees land at '<hostCheckout>-sessions/<session>'.

hostShadows.description: Tools (e.g. 'pwsh', 'git') to wrap from the Windows host into a per-project bin dir that's prepended to PATH only for sessions of this hostProject. Names are resolved via 'where.exe <tool>.exe' first, then a built-in candidate list. Use the object form to pin a specific Windows .exe.

icon.description: Windows Terminal tab icon for this project's sessions: a file path, emoji, 'ms-appdata:///...' reference, or built-in glyph. Stored verbatim and emitted into a generated WT profile fragment (icon/backgroundImage need a WT profile; wt.exe has no CLI flag for them).

backgroundImage.description: Windows Terminal background image for this project's sessions: a Windows file path, URL, or the literal 'desktopWallpaper'. Stored verbatim and emitted into the generated WT profile fragment.

backgroundImageOpacity.description: Opacity percent of the background image: 0 = fully transparent, 100 = solid. Overrides projectDefaults.backgroundImageOpacity. Only meaningful alongside backgroundImage.

projectDefaults.description: Default values applied to every project unless the project overrides them.

backgroundImageOpacity.description: Default background-image opacity percent (0 = fully transparent, 100 = solid) for projects that set a backgroundImage but no per-project backgroundImageOpacity.

claudeFile.description: Deprecated: use claudeShared.claudeMd. Still honored for back-compat (maps onto claudeShared.claudeMd); claudeShared wins when both are present.

claudeShared.description: Shared account-level Claude store (CLAUDE.md + skills/ + agents/) symlinked into every project user's ~/.claude. The store is a Windows host folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\claudearium\.claude) drvfs-mounted into the distro, so it SURVIVES distro nuke. Content is seeded from the host and editable in-distro (shared across all projects); reconcile manages only the store structure, never overwriting content.

claudeMd.description: Seed source for the shared CLAUDE.md. 'skip' leaves it unmanaged.

importSkills.description: Import %USERPROFILE%\.claude\skills into the store at setup / on `claude-shared import`.

importAgents.description: Import %USERPROFILE%\.claude\agents into the store at setup / on `claude-shared import`.

skillsPath.description: Override host source dir for skills (default %USERPROFILE%\.claude\skills).

agentsPath.description: Override host source dir for agents (default %USERPROFILE%\.claude\agents).

backup.description: Optional host-side point-in-time snapshots of the store. The store is host-mounted and survives nuke on its own, so these are extra version snapshots, not the durability mechanism.

onNuke.description: Snapshot the store to %LOCALAPPDATA%\claudearium\backups\<distro> before nuke. Off by default — the host-mounted store already survives nuke.

retain.description: Keep the newest N snapshots (0 = unlimited).

restorePrompt.description: Prompt to restore the newest snapshot during setup when one exists.
